newsitem.title: USA: Sun Health to buy Retirement Care, Contour.
newsitem.headline: Sun Health to buy Retirement Care, Contour.

text.p: Sun Healthcare Group Inc said Tuesday it had signed definitive agreements to acquire Retirement Care Associates Inc and Contour Medical Inc.

Sun will issue 0.6625 share of its stock for each Retirement Care share, and will pay $8.50 a share in cash or stock, at Sun's election, for the about 35 percent of Contour stock not presently owned by Retirement Care.
The combined transactions are valued at about $328 million, including the assumption of all outstanding debt of Atlanta-based Retirement Care and St. Petersburg-based Contour.
Retirement Care owns about 65 percent of the outstanding shares of Contour, a national provider of medical and surgical supplies for the long-term care industry and specialty products for hospitals.
The parties contemplate closing on the transactions in the second or third quarter of 1997.
The boards of all three firms have unanimously approved their respective agreements.

Holders of about 36 percent of the outstanding shares of Retirement Care have agreed to vote their shares in favor of the merger and have granted Sun Healthcare an option to buy their shares under certain circumstances, Sun said.
Sun will assume management of all Retirement Care and Contour operations upon completion of the deals.
None of the senior management of Retirement Care is expected to continue in the management of the combined operations, Sun said.
